title: pipeline.yaml
description: The only pipeline authoring surface in v0 (SPEC.md §9, ADR-005). Validate the YAML document after decoding it to JSON. Derived from internal/pipeline.Pipeline, which decodes with KnownFields(true) — hence additionalProperties: false — plus the `uses:` key mandated by ADR-004, which the planner does not consume yet.

not.description: `waterfall:` is reserved syntax: the parser MUST accept the key and reject it with 'not implemented in v0' (SPEC.md §9), so a document carrying it is not a valid v0 pipeline.

version.description: Format version. Defaults to 1 when omitted; v0 understands only 1.

source.description: The one source step. Required. `when:` is not allowed on it.

steps.description: Middle steps, executed strictly in order.

waterfall.description: Reserved (SPEC.md §9). Present only so v1 can add it without a format break; any value here MUST be rejected in v0.

not.description: Reserved on a step too; rejected in v0.

id.description: Step id, unique within the pipeline. Defaults to 'source' / 'step-N' / 'deliver'.

with.description: The step's config, validated against the adapter's config_schema. Sent as OPEN.config.

uses.description: ADR-004: an AI step's dynamic needs. Valid only on steps whose adapter role is filter/compose or another AI-backed role. The planner MUST validate it exactly as needs.required (SPEC.md §7), and at execution time the projected fields object MUST be built from `uses` rather than from the manifest's open-ended `needs`.

when.description: Gate. v0 supports only '<step_id>.passed', referencing an earlier step.

cache.description: Freshness-window override for this step, e.g. '30d'.

idempotency.description: Deliver steps: the field whose value keys a delivery. Defaults to the identity key (SPEC.md §8).
